summary: This 8-K reports early termination of the HSR waiting period for the merger of Catalyst Pharmaceuticals into a subsidiary of Angelini Pharma. Under the Merger Agreement announced May 6, 2026, Catalyst will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Angelini Pharma, taking the company private. The transaction is subject to customary conditions including stockholder approval. The parties expect closing in Q3 2026. No price terms are stated in this filing. The risk-arb angle is the remaining regulatory and stockholder vote timeline.
